title: Northgate Marketplace Cancellation Terms by Seller Program
content:
**Cancellation terms.** Under Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee, a buyer's cancellation request, the seller's time to answer it, the late-shipment cancellation right and the refund on a canceled order follow the seller program of the order. The six seller programs of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee are Northgate Marketplace Seller-Fulfilled, Northgate Marketplace Pro Seller, Northgate Marketplace Fulfilled by Northgate, Northgate Marketplace Freight Seller, Northgate Marketplace Certified Renewed and Northgate Marketplace International Seller; the columns below carry their names without the Northgate Marketplace prefix.

| Term | Seller-Fulfilled | Pro Seller | Fulfilled by Northgate | Freight Seller | Certified Renewed | International Seller |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Order statuses in which the buyer may ask to cancel | placed | placed | placed | placed | placed | placed |
| Business days within which the seller must accept or decline a buyer cancellation request | 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Business days after the handling deadline after which an unshipped order may be canceled by the buyer with a full refund | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Refund on a canceled order | full amount paid | full amount paid | full amount paid | full amount paid | full amount paid | full amount paid |

**Note.** A seller answer time of 0 under Fulfilled by Northgate reflects that Northgate itself fulfils those items; the figure on every other program is 1 business day, and the late-shipment figure is 3 business days on all six programs.
